name: project-scaffold
description: Browser-based software architecture editor exporting YAML/JSON for code skeleton generators
author: Mickaël Blet

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p vscode
scripts.vscode:compile: tsc -p vscode && esbuild vscode/src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:vscode --outfile=vscode/out/extension.js && mkdir -p vscode/media && cp dist-web/index.html electron/icon.png vscode/media/ && cp LICENSE vscode/
scripts.vscode:package: npm run vscode:compile && mkdir -p dist-vscode && cd vscode && vsce package $npm_package_version --no-git-tag-version --no-update-package-json --no-dependencies --out ../dist-vscode/
scripts.vscode:build: npm run build && npm run vscode:package
